title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19562, 2026.1.14137, 2025.3.169041 missing authorization allowed attaching tags to…
description: A missing authorization vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack versions prior to 2026.2.19562, 2026.1.14137, and 2025.3.169041 allows users with limited privileges to attach tags to any issue via the tag issues collection. This issue has a low severity impact and does not affect confidentiality or availability.
